messages:
alina: Quick postmortem follow-up for incident 3120043210. Summary: reconnect storms + tight keepalive -> KV cache pressure -> partial/timeout streams. We split into three tracks: runtime heartbeat, client backoff/circuit, routing fallbacks.
samir: Soft-fallbacks + throttles preferred over rollback.
devon: I'll do heartbeat tuning: idle_keepalive=15s, jitter=0.2, max_missed=3, prefetch_cache_ttl=30s. Canary to staging and measure partial_chunk_rate. ETA Wed EOD.
marco: I'll own client backoff & SDK changes. Plan: exp backoff capped at 30s, max_attempts=6, client-side circuit-breaker when partial_rate>5% over 60s; add opt-in graceful-downgrade header. PR Tue AM.
sre_lead: Ops will implement surge thresholds + soft-fallback routing (route to non-stream / smaller model) and add composite alert (partials + queue growth).
ops-bot: Created INF-5901: "Streaming surge thresholds & fallback runbook" https://redwood/INF-5901
oncall-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: heartbeat config to staging at 3140001000 UTC.
devon: Adding metric missed_heartbeats_per_session and partial_chunk_trace_id, will instrument p50/p95.
marco: SDK remains backward compatible; adding integration tests and infra-perf scenario to reproduce bursty short streams.
alina: Timeline recap: Devon (heartbeat) Wed EOD, Marco (SDK/backoff) Tue AM, Ops (runbook & alerts) Fri EOD. 4-week observation window; rollback gate if partial_response_rate > 3% sustained. Next sync Tue 09:30 PT.
alina: Closing: priority = observability (partial-response traces) so we can correlate truncated streams to reconnects/network events. Please link PRs & test outputs to INF-5901 before Tue sync. Thanks all. :wave:
